description: The transcripts of SASPEECH. No recipe reads them. Its transcripts are SASPEECH's metadata tables, inside archives that total about 11 GB, and a fetch holds a whole download in memory, so no fetch can read them (see https://github.com/Mearman/keepset/issues/212).
